custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin who can switch between two locations: the test location and location B.
  • Create a part, part A, for this test at the test location and at location B under the same part number, so a rename reaches location B too.
  • Create a part, part B, for this test at location B only, so location B stocks a part the new number will look like.
  • Use a new number for part A that differs from part B's number only by a hyphen or a period, so the two numbers match once punctuation is ignored, but no entry has it exactly.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Location B is Staging Lethbridge - 4310. To switch: click the box at the top right, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Lethbridge - 4310. Switch back to Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 the same way.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839448-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839448-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens for part A.

Step 3:

  • Part Number shows the look-alike number.

Step 4:

  • The save is refused and the window stays open.
  • A red message reads part B's number followed by "already exists at" and location B's name, then a full stop, with a smaller second line "Please try to resolve this."
  • The message is not "already belongs to another part in the Part Library.": no entry has exactly the typed number.

Step 5:

  • The red message has gone on its own after about 3 seconds, and the window is still open.

Step 6:

  • The window closes and part A is still listed under its old number.

Step 7:

  • The location selector shows location B.

Step 8:

  • The Parts left menu shows Inventory.

Step 9:

  • Location B's Inventory page opens.

Step 10:

  • Part B is listed at location B with its own number, unchanged.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 35 (edited 27 Oct 2026 by Chris Ward), read 28 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog)

  • S13-N1a: “The save is also refused when another part, at any other location that stocks this part, has a number that matches the typed one, ignoring upper and lower case, hyphens, asterisks, periods and spaces. The dialog stays open, and the system shows "{existing part number} already exists at {location}." A match at the part's own location is refused with S7-N3 or S7-N4 instead. On the Part Library detail page, which has no current location, S13-N1a applies at every location.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Renamed number matches a part at another location that stocks it | "{existing part number} already exists at {location}." | Error toast, fades after 3 seconds; the dialog stays open”
  • Story 13, context note: “Context note: every refusal sent by the system, the rows that fade after 3 seconds, also shows a second, smaller line under the message: "Please try to resolve this." Messages the screen builds itself carry their own second line, as listed, or none.”

From: Product's answers to questions 13 to 27 (Chris Ward, 27 Oct 2026, Google Doc https://docs.google.com/document/d/1pkAPGqWVTdtYorNN4SVNl9HkHxuuB9czro_y2DbUeEM/edit, saved word for word in full-pass-2026-10-27/ANSWERS-13-27-2026-10-27.md), read 28 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward, 27 Oct 2026, answer 23: “"AB-100 already exists at this location." (S7-N3), or the inactive version (S7-N4) if the AB-100 here is inactive. The "{location}" wording shows only for a clash at another location that stocks the part, or for a rename made on the Part Library page (S13-N1a).”

From: Jira tickets and comments under epic SV-10647 (saved in sources/jira-2026-10-27/ALL-TICKETS-2026-10-27.md), read 27 Oct 2026

  • SV-10826, comment, Chris Ward, 23 Oct 2026: “Refuse when any location that stocks the entry already has a part matching the new number (ignoring case and punctuation).”

Last checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026.
